name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server for searching the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace + Degen Arena + portfolio risk scoring + cross-portfolio composition. Exposes 37 tools — including the v0.10.0 composites (acp_hire_decision, acp_safe_quote, acp_portfolio_status) and OracleBot Resource wrappers (acp_oracle_sources, acp_oracle_drift, acp_oracle_capabilities) on top of the v0.9.1 risk bundle (acp_agent_verify and friends), Degen Arena tools, and the v0.7+ Resources / cost / feed-address suite — backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
